cases.reviewerAnswer: Not applicable: this case contains lesson explanations rather than a learner task.
cases.defect: The categorical qualification «один раз» is misleading. Singular el sábado can also have a habitual reading in a description of someone's routine, such as El sábado descanso y el domingo trabajo.
cases.correction: Explain that los sábados explicitly expresses recurrence, while el sábado usually identifies a particular Saturday but can also express recurrence in a habitual context.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, discussion of temporal expressions with weekday names and habitual interpretations (from memory).
cases.notes: The mañana explanation would also benefit from specifying its adverbial use: article absence alone does not distinguish tomorrow from morning, as esta mañana illustrates.

cases.reviewerAnswer: Nunca bebo café por la noche. Other valid formulations include No tomo nunca café por la noche; por la tarde is also possible when «ввечері» refers to early evening.
cases.element: context.taughtBefore: missing the supporting constructions por la noche / por la tarde required by task.prompt[0].text, "Переклади іспанською: «Я ніколи не п’ю каву ввечері»."
cases.defect: The prerequisite mapping omits the part-of-day constructions newly introduced in this lesson. This is a prerequisite-record defect; the supplied lesson does contain the necessary teaching in s1.
cases.correction: Add the earlier s1 teaching of time.parts-of-day, including por la tarde and por la noche, to this case's taughtBefore, or supply the necessary expressions in a vocabulary hint.

cases.reviewerAnswer: Todos los días trabajo en la oficina y los fines de semana descanso. Cada día is also suitable in the first slot; el fin de semana can have the required habitual reading in the second.
cases.notes: Accepting singular el fin de semana is appropriate in this routine context. Both slots remain open, so other acceptable expressions are not automatically graded incorrect.
